summary: Reliance Global Group filed an amendment to its Form 8-K to correct the closing date of a previously reported acquisition, now stated as completed September 24, 2026, upon the Buyer's delivery of the cash portion of the closing payment and a promissory note under a Letter Agreement. The Item 2.01 disclosure is amended and restated in its entirety; no other changes were made. The 8-K/A, signed by CEO Ezra Beyman, includes Item 9.01 financial statements and exhibits. Deal specifics—price, premium, and target identity—were not restated in this excerpt, leaving terms largely undisclosed. Watch for the amended purchase price allocation, note terms and any earnout, plus the target's standalone financials for valuation clarity.
